run_external_controller_server: run a FastAPI server to externally control the EAR agent framework via HTTP endpoints
execute_long_horizon_task: execute a long-horizon task by sending a task instruction to the agent via the execute_lh_task endpoint
stream_framework_status: stream the EAR framework status at 1Hz to monitor agent health and long-horizon task progress
stream_events: stream events of specified types from the event bus as an SSE feed to the client
publish_event: publish an event to the agent framework event bus via a POST request with type, source, data, and metadata
